    # The rsa_public_key must be a public key (not private key, not None, not empty string)
    # _prepare_key_plus will raise TypeError if it's not a valid public key
    key = _prepare_key_plus(alg, rsa_public_key)

    norm_params = normalize_parameters(request.params)
    bs_uri = base_string_uri(request.uri)
    sig_base_str = signature_base_string(request.http_method, bs_uri, norm_params)

    message = sig_base_str.encode('ascii')

    # Decode the base64-encoded signature

    except Exception:
